description: One provisional 2022 news-reported winner per municipal ward. Sex, reservation and votes are unreported and remain null.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Election year of the dated news list.

fields.name: ward_no
fields.description: Printed ward number; null only for the roster's unlabeled entry.

fields.name: winner
fields.description: Reported winner name in the original script and spelling.

fields.name: party
fields.description: Normalized party: BJP, INC or IND; mapping documented in README.

fields.name: winner_woman
fields.description: Unreported by these lists; always null, not inferred from names.

fields.name: reserved_woman
fields.description: Unreported by these lists; always null.

fields.name: votes
fields.description: Unreported by these lists; always null.

fields.name: source_status
fields.description: Evidence status; current roster is not an election result.

fields.name: source_path
fields.description: Original file path relative to the repository root.

fields.name: source_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the complete original source bytes.

fields.name: source_row
fields.description: One-based extracted list or CMS array position.

fields.name: raw_line
fields.description: Unchanged extracted line supporting the name, ward and party.
